# Question Operations

## Restart the API service

The API service uses `restart --no-verify` on 2026-10-03 from
`/srv/backups/kb`.

## Deploy the API service

Deploy the API service with the standard release workflow.

## Backup location

Backups live at `/srv/backups/kb`.

## API hostname

The API hostname is `api.internal.example`.
